title: Dropping a Button into the Button original you are editing stops making every copy a giant box
goal: While you edit a component's original, dragging a copy of that same component (or any other tile) onto the page silently becomes part of the original, so on Done every copy in the document turns into a large box holding the dropped things, including a copy of itself. A component should never be able to contain itself, and a drop beside the drawing should not quietly grow it.
notes: Found by an-instance-s-properties-match-the-variants-mock on 2026-10-09. Reproduced with the walk saved at queue/evidence/2026-10-09-selfdrop-walk.json: Scripts/playtest.sh queue/evidence/2026-10-09-selfdrop-walk.json --no-build -> status ok, 4 real captures in /tmp/photonz-playtest/selfdrop. Steps: blank 1440x1024; showComponentShelf; dragTile Button to [420,300]; action editPickedComponentOriginal; dragTile Button to [600,600] (panel rows then: Button (layer, copy), Button (group, shut, original): the copy sits in the space beside the original); dragTile Card to [900,300]; action doneEditingOriginal. Result in 4-back-sc.png: toast Updated 1 copy of Button; the copy on the page is now a ~300x230 blue box with the Card in its top right, the label Button, and a component mark in its bottom left (the nested copy of itself). Swap already guards against a component holding itself (componentSwapChoices dims it); the drop into the original space does not. Code: EditorState+OriginalSpace.swift (editOriginal / finishEditingOriginal), the drop path in EditorState+Components.swift placeComponent / insertStarterComponent. The existing component-versions-walk and tutorial walks also drop tiles while the space is open, so check them when fixing.
acceptance: Dropping a tile of the component you are editing onto its own original is refused, with a short canvas notice saying why, and nothing changes
Dropping anything onto the page beside the original, outside its drawing, does not grow the original, or the user has decided on a card what it should do
Pressing Done after either drop leaves every copy the size and look it had before
A walk at Next defaults drops a Button into its own original and a Card beside it, presses Done, and photographs the copies unchanged

log.note: Daily triage 2026-10-09: moved to the front of p2. It is the one open defect that silently changes a user's document (every copy turns into a giant box on Done), so it goes ahead of the new icon and redline features.
